SCIENCE PASSAGE 2: Mulch and Soil Infiltration
Students packed identical soil columns and applied simulated rain. Experiment 1 compared bare soil with 2 cm and 5 cm layers of straw mulch. They measured water collected below each column after 20 minutes. Experiment 2 repeated the treatments after gently compacting the soil.

At 2, what was the absolute difference between Uncompacted soil and Compacted soil?
questions.explanation: Read the two requested values and subtract; report the absolute difference.

questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 5: Protective Coatings and Corrosion
Steel washers were cleaned, weighed, and coated with no coating, wax, paint, or a plant-based film. The washers were placed in equal volumes of saltwater for 10 days, dried, and reweighed. Greater mass loss indicates more corrosion. A second observation recorded the percentage of each surface covered by rust.

At Wax, what was the absolute difference between Mass loss and Rust coverage (scaled)?
questions.explanation: Read the two requested values and subtract; report the absolute difference.
